title: Kiki's Delivery Service Novels Get Live-Action TV Series from BBC Studios, Wheel in Motion, Kadokawa
content: Irena Brignull ( The Box Trolls , The Little Prince ) is writing the series. The six volumes of Kadono's fantasy novel series Majo no Takkyūbin follow the coming of age of Kiki with her black cat Jiji. Kadono began the main novel series in 1985 and ended it in 2009.
author: ANN

title: Chainsaw Man’s Live-Action Adaptation is Coming to America
content: Live-action anime adaptations have never been bigger, and while not every property has been confirmed for a live-action television series and/or feature-length film, franchises are still breaking through in unique ways.

title: My Hero Academia Releases 10th Anniversary Video Celebrating Deku's Journey With New Animation
content: My Hero Academia has released a special anniversary video as part of the anime’s ongoing 10th anniversary celebration, showing Izuku Midoriya’s journey from a Quirkless boy to the greatest hero through some of the series’ most memorable moments.

title: A Yamaha X Botan Popup Event Is Coming to Shibuya
content: Yamaha is once again showing its love for kawaii anime girls. The company has announced a collaboration event with the Botan Kamiina Fully Blossoms When Drunk TV anime. The Yamaha x Botan popup event, named Horoyoi Sound Terrace, will take place at Yamaha Sound Crossing Shibuya from June 27 to August 16.
author: Anime Corner

title: Ghost in the Shell: The Ghost in the Shell Confirms Global Prime Video Streaming, Releases New Trailer
content: THE GHOST IN THE SHELL anime by Science SARU has confirmed its global streaming plans ahead of its July premiere, with Prime Video set to simulcast the anime in Japan and more than 240 countries and territories worldwide. Prime Video will begin streaming the episodes just 30 minutes after Japan at 11:30 p.m.

title: Chainsaw Man: Reze Arc Movie Featured on First MAPPA 15th Anniversary Key Visual
content: MAPPA has revealed the first commemorative key visual for its upcoming 15th anniversary presentation, featuring Chainsaw Man – The Movie: Reze Arc with a new illustration created exclusively for the event.
